messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — proposing a short go/no-go for the release cut (release-2026-03-31). Two slots: Wed Mar 30 16:00 PT or Thu Mar 31 09:00 PT. Need owners for canary, smoke, DB rollback, infra lead. Short agenda below. Please react with ✅ for the slot you prefer or reply if neither works.

James Park: Thu 09:00 PT works for me. Can we keep it to 30m? Focused items only.

Chris O'Neill: I can only do Wed 16:00 PT. If we go Thu I might only be available for the first ~20m.

Priya Patel: Please add RFC-482 (tokenizer change) — could affect model startup and caching. Need a 5-min slot to call out risk.

Maria Chen: Good call, Priya. Compact agenda suggestion: 
```
- Rollcall & quick blockers (5m)
- Release readiness (10m)
  - model artifacts & signatures
  - infra capacity + autoscale checks
- RFC-482 impact (5m)
- Canary plan & owners (5m)
- Final go/no-go vote + rollback triggers (5m)
```
Target total: 30m (can stretch to 35m if RFC needs a bit more).

Elena Gomez: I'm +1 for Thu 09:00 PT and can own canary + smoke validation. If we need extra 5m for RFC I'm fine with 35m.

James Park: Ok 35m Thu 09:00 PT then — I'll own DB rollback plan and run through the DB cut checklist.

deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled: canary deployment on staging at 2026-03-29T22:00Z. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/5678/logs. Will post summary after run.

Chris O'Neill: If Thu is confirmed, I'll join for the infra/high-level first 20m then hand off to Elena for the canary portion.

Maria Chen: Final roster (so far): Maria Chen (host/moderator), Elena Gomez (canary + smoke owner), James Park (DB rollback owner), Priya Patel (RFC owner & presenter), Chris O'Neill (infra lead — partial). Tag other stakeholders now if needed (security/compliance/legal).

Priya Patel: I'll prepare a 2-slide summary and a short perf-run snippet to show before the vote — targeting <2 minutes.

James Park: I'll post the DB rollback playbook and a short runbook snippet in this thread by EOD tomorrow.

Maria Chen: Thanks all — locking Thu Mar 31 09:00 PT (meeting length 35m). I'll send the calendar invite with the agenda and attach the playbooks once we have them. If anyone cannot attend, DM me and we can arrange a delegate.

Elena Gomez: Acknowledged — will prep canary checklist and smoke run steps.

Chris O'Neill: Acknowledged. I'll try to extend if the RFC discussion needs it but expect to drop after infra check.

Maria Chen: One last ask — please paste any last-minute blocking PRs or critical flaky tests into this thread so we can triage ahead of the meeting.

James Park: will do.

Priya Patel: posting perf snippet link tomorrow.

Maria Chen: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
